lead.event: Bank Indonesia reserve-requirement cut and interest-rate decision
lead.headline: Bank Indonesia holds BI-Rate at 5.75% and cuts reserve requirements
lead.blurb: Reports estimate the reserve changes will release Rp90 trillion to Rp97 trillion in bank liquidity, while the Deposit Facility rate rises 25 basis points to 5%. BI said banks have flexibility over where to lend the funds, but must still commit to lending under its liquidity incentive policy. The changes will be phased in from 1 November and 1 December.

market_structure_policy.event: IDX extends PTPP suspension amid debt restructuring and missed payments
market_structure_policy.headline: IDX extends PTPP suspension amid Rp18.2 trillion debt restructuring
market_structure_policy.blurb: PP shares remain suspended across all markets from 23 October until further notice after missed interest and profit-sharing payments due 22 October. Its restructuring agreement with creditor banks, covering Rp18.2 trillion of debt, took effect on 21 October.

market_structure_policy.event: IDX suspension following PT Guna Timur Raya’s share surge
market_structure_policy.headline: IDX suspends TRUK after 87.1% weekly surge
market_structure_policy.blurb: Andry Hakim’s investment value rose from Rp9.3 billion to Rp131 billion, a gain of about Rp121 billion. Hakimson Growth Capital and Pukul Rata Kanan previously acquired a combined 20% stake at Rp428 per share, and Hakim says the pair have undisclosed plans and an agreement that could allow their ownership to increase.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Amman Mineral plans a share buyback
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: AMMN plans share buyback of up to Rp1 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Amman Mineral plans to fund the program with internal cash and buy back up to 0.37% of its placed and paid-up capital from 22 October to 22 January 2027. Analysts expect the effect on the share price to be limited because the number of shares is relatively small.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: PACK plans a rights issue pending shareholder approval
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: PACK plans 100 billion-share rights issue pending shareholder approval
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Abadi Nusantara Hijau Investama will seek approval at a 30 November meeting for the issue. It plans to raise up to USD463 million to repay loans, buy Denway Development shares and fund working capital. Eco Energi Perkasa will guarantee up to USD418 million of unsubscribed shares, while non-participants could face dilution of about 74.6%.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: PT Visi Media Asia’s planned share issuance without pre-emptive rights
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: VIVA plans to issue up to 43.09 billion shares without pre-emptive rights
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Visi Media Asia would issue Series C shares to settle remaining Senior Facility debt. The exercise price would be the higher of Rp40 or the 25-day average closing price before the listing application, and existing shareholders could face dilution of up to 72.35%. Shareholders will vote on the plan on 17 November.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: UVCR reports nine-month profit growth and plans a private placement
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: UVCR reports 395.8% profit growth, plans placement of up to 200 million shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Net profit reached Rp10.63 billion for January–September 2026, up from Rp2.14 billion a year earlier. Shareholders are due to consider the proposed issue on 27 October, with proceeds earmarked mainly for working capital, product and service development, operational capacity and marketing.
capital_raising_buybacks.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: Nine-month net profit rose 395.8% to Rp10.63 billion.

deals_control.event: Adhi Karya schedules meeting to consider divestment and rights-proceeds reallocation
deals_control.headline: ADHI schedules meeting on Rp1.76 trillion JMJ sale and rights-fund shift
deals_control.blurb: Adhi Karya will seek approval to sell 1,714,808 JMJ shares, or 47.18%, for Rp1.76 trillion and redirect Rp378.69 billion in remaining rights issue proceeds from investment entities to working capital for ongoing construction projects. The meeting is scheduled for 13 November.

deals_control.event: BUMI reports quarterly growth and mineral diversification activity
deals_control.headline: BUMI reports 27.2% revenue growth and buys Loyal Metals for AUD79.07 million
deals_control.blurb: Bumi's revenue reached US$858 million and net profit US$59 million, up 27.2% and 188.4% year on year, respectively. The 100% acquisition expands its exposure to copper, gold and lithium.
deals_control.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

earnings_guidance.event: Bank Mandiri reports nine-month 2026 earnings and broker target-price reactions
earnings_guidance.headline: BMRI reports Rp45.5 trillion nine-month profit as brokers set target prices
earnings_guidance.blurb: Bank Mandiri’s profit rose 20.7% year on year. Samuel Sekuritas maintained its buy rating and Rp4,900 target, implying 25.6% upside, while Sucor Sekuritas maintained hold and raised its target to Rp4,350.

earnings_guidance.headline: BTPS reports nine-month 2026 profit up 7% to Rp1.01 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Assets rose 8% to Rp24 trillion and financing increased 13% to Rp11 trillion through September. Director Fachmy Achmad attributed the growth to healthier financing quality and sustained customer empowerment.

earnings_guidance.headline: FORE reports 9M 2026 revenue up 53.3% to Rp1.6 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Fore Kopi Indonesia’s EBITDA rose 70.6% to Rp342.2 billion and net profit climbed 49.7% to Rp90 billion, Mandiri Sekuritas said, though profit was slightly below its expectations. The group added more than 70 Fore Coffee outlets, bringing its network to 410 stores across Indonesia and Singapore.

earnings_guidance.event: PT Sat Nusapersada H1 2026 revenue results and stock surge
earnings_guidance.headline: PTSN revenue rises 65.2% as shares gain 24.46%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Sat Nusapersada reported first-half revenue of US$182.28 million, while gross margin narrowed to 8.1% from 13.9% and profit before tax fell to US$6.13 million. The 23 October share move followed speculation the company could assemble or produce devices for a government plan to distribute free phones to at least 25 million adults, with a Rp27.61 trillion budget.
